title: Specimen Collection Appointments: Household Charge for Additional Members Drawn at a Home Visit
content:
## The charge

When additional household members are drawn at a collected Mobile In-Home Collection Visit of **Specimen Collection Appointments**, the visit carries a household charge for them. The household charge for the additional household members drawn at a collected home visit is worked out by calculation rather than as a flat amount per member. It is posted on the visit as one assessed additional-patient fee, dated the day it is posted, and the patient then sees it in the visit's fee history as an assessed additional-patient fee owed until settled.

The household charge on a home visit is fixed only after the visit carries an assessed trip fee. Put in terms of the visit's fee record: until that record shows an assessed trip fee, the household charge of the visit is not yet fixed.

## Posting tool: `assess_household_fee_59046739`

**Capability.** Posts the household charge for the additional household members drawn at a collected home collection visit. One call adds one assessed additional-patient fee line, dated today, to the visit's collection-service fee record and raises the visit's outstanding collection-fee balance by that amount.

**Invocation.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `assess_household_fee_59046739` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

- `visit_id` — identifier: the reference number of the collection visit at which the household members were drawn, as read from the visit lookup for the patient.
- `fee_amount` — fixed format: the household charge to post, in USD, a positive amount given to 2 decimal places (cents); the value is posted exactly as given, already rounded to the cent.

**Return.** A receipt carrying `visit_event_id` (the reference number of the new assessed additional-patient fee line), `visit_id` (the visit charged), `fee_type` (always `additional_patient_fee`), `fee_amount` (the amount posted in USD to 2 decimal places), `event_date` (today's posting date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `fee_balance` (the visit's outstanding collection-fee balance in USD after posting). A receipt carrying a `visit_event_id` means the charge is on the visit.

## Basis Q&A

**Which visits carry a household charge?** A collected Mobile In-Home Collection Visit at which one or more additional household members were drawn.

**How many household charges can one visit carry?** One; a fee type is assessed at most once per visit.
